regions.today: Mostly cloudy for much of the day with occasional outbreaks of rain, drizzle and mist. A clearance will only start to move down from the northwest later, with some rain and drizzle even lingering into tonight in some southeastern coastal parts. A cooler day with afternoon temperatures of 11 to 15 degrees, cooler in the north, with light to moderate northerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Any lingering rain in the southeast will clear overnight, leaving a dry night for many with clear spells. Towards morning, some isolated showers will develop in the northwest of the province. Colder than previous nights, with lowest temperatures of 1 to 7 degrees, with a light west to northwest breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday, will be a cool and bright autumnal day for many with plenty of sunshine though some scattered showers will spread from the northwest through the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 10 to 14 degrees, with a moderate to fresh northwesterly breeze.
